title: wulffhound campaign spec
description: A campaign = materials x facets x levels x temperatures under one force-field route, protocol, budget and policy. The planner (wulffhound/campaign.py) expands it into jobs, skips what the dataset already has, estimates the CPU, orders and cuts at the budget; the executor (campaign_exec.py) runs the jobs through a backend; ingest (campaign_ingest.py) turns finished jobs into surface_energy records. Written as YAML or JSON. Every field except campaign and materials has a default (shown).

campaign.description: name: the journal (state/campaigns/<name>/) and the dataset store (dataset/campaigns/<name>.jsonl)

materials.description: a string is a name, material_id or InChIKey: a wulffhound bundle material (tnt, paracetamol) first, then a CIF-zoo entry of the chain (naphthalene, benzoic-acid, ...). An object can name a CIF (run through cif2lammps first) or a chain example folder.

cif.description: path of a CIF (relative to the spec, the repository or the chain; chain:... allowed)

example.description: a chain example folder with inputs.yaml, e.g. chain:surfenergy/examples/tnt001_nonreactive

id.description: material_id for a material the dataset does not know yet

level_facets.description: per-level facet selections, keys '1' '2' '3' (the forms of facets); a level not named here uses facets

levels.description: 1 unrelaxed screening (supercell + slabcutter), 2 relaxed T = 0 (surfenergy temperature 0), 3 MD at T > 0 (surfenergy with the md lengths). Default [1]

temperatures.description: K; levels 1 and 2 are T = 0, level 3 runs every T > 0 here. Default [0]

protocol.description: overrides; null = the tool's own default

n_periods.description: slab thickness in periods (default 2, as every dataset record so far)

search_range.description: null: bundle materials use the engine's smallest known cell, others 4

slab_from.description: levels 2-3; null = surfenergy's default (relaxed_bulk since R3)

angle_dev.description: supercell's GCCM angle_dev, degrees (null: the tool's default, 1)

cell_fallbacks.description: non-bundle materials: oriented-cell settings tried in order after (search_range, angle_dev) when the estimator finds no cell, slabcutter's ReaxFF memory rule refuses the cell, or the estimate is over the per-run cap; each is merged over the protocol's values, and at each the family member with the smallest estimated cell is used

cpu_minutes.description: total estimated CPU of the jobs that run (default 30)

per_run_cap_minutes.description: a job estimated above this is not run (default 6)

policy.description: exhaustive: the spec's order; baseline: the deterministic greedy policy (level 1 in BFDH order, then relevance / cost); agent: plan only, the queue is left for the MCP agent. Default baseline

backend.description: local: the chain through chain_runner (works now); nanohub: simtool Run against installed revisions; aura: the AURA MCP run_sim2l. The last two need the Sim2Ls installed on nanoHUB

timeout_factor.description: a job is stopped after max(300 s, factor x its estimate + 120 s) (default 3)

nanohub.description: revision: {tool: revision number}, venue (e.g. a cluster queue), walltime_minutes, ncpus

retry_failed.description: true: run a job whose exact key failed before; 'other_cell': only when the planned oriented cell (hkl, search_range, angle_dev) differs from the one that failed; default false (failures are never retried blindly)

facets.description: a list of families / hkl ('{0 1 1}', [1, 0, 0]); or 'bfdh_top_N'; or 'max_index K'; or 'on_shape' (families on the material's current shape in the dataset); or 'wulff_priority' (the families on a shape of the material first, then those within its uncertainty, then the rest of its facet set in BFDH order; the level's jobs wait until that shape is in the dataset, and `run` re-plans after each ingest); or an object

shape_level.description: on_shape: which shape (default best); wulff_priority: the shape it ranks on (default 1)

k_sigma.description: wulff_priority: an off-shape family is within the uncertainty when it is on the shape in some sensitivity samples, or appears when its gamma is lowered by k_sigma x its sigma (default 2)

target_ok.description: run jobs (in the policy's order) only until this many families of the selection have an ok value for the material and level; the dataset's and this campaign's count, failed or refused ones do not, so a refused cell makes room for the next family

min_area.description: on_shape: area fraction above which a family is on the shape (default 1e-4)

limit_new.description: at most this many new jobs per material and level for this campaign (after the dataset look-up and the per-run cap), in selection order; jobs the campaign already ran count towards it

forcefield.description: route: 'auto' (the material's own: ReaxFF for CIF/zoo materials, the bundle's for tnt/paracetamol), 'reaxff' (ffield file), 'nonreactive' (a typed data file with full topology + its run-0 script); further routes register in campaign.FORCEFIELD_ROUTES
